name: Hugo
source:
[i]"I don't want some petty squabble getting in the way of work that needs doing."[/i]

Yves's friend and partner at Courrune. He is also a member of the Corps. He is cheerful, caring, and highly trusted by those around him. While generally positive, he also has a thoughtful approach to things because of the life experience he's accumulated as a Reliver.

[b]Occupation:[/b] Courrune handyman, Corps member

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/vircheevermore/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
